info.title: Fiscal Data Service Universal API
info.description: Access public U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data APIs for federal debt, cash balances, receipts, outlays, revenue collections, exchange rates, interest costs, securities, and related fiscal datasets.

get.description: Retrieves average interest rate records from Fiscal Data Service.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Fields to sort by, with an optional direction for each field.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.
